title: Purley Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency health facilities, flood hazards, and essential supply points for Purley.
content: For life-threatening emergencies, call 999 immediately. 1. Nearest Hospitals with 24-Hour A&E: - Croydon University Hospital (530 London Road, Thornton Heath, CR7 7YE). Directions from Purley Station: ~3.8 miles north; take train to East Croydon then bus 60/109/250, or take bus 466 north along A235 Brighton Road. - St George's Hospital (Blackshaw Road, Tooting, SW17 0QT) — Designated Major Trauma Centre. Directions from Purley Station: ~7.5 miles north-west; take Southern train to Balham then Northern Line to Tooting Broadway, or drive north-west via A23/A214. 2. NHS Urgent Treatment Centres: - Purley Urgent Treatment Centre (Purley War Memorial Hospital, 856 Brighton Road, Purley, CR8 2YL). Directions from Purley Station: ~6 min walk south along Brighton Road (0.3 miles). Treats minor cuts, burns, muscle sprains, and uncomplicated fractures. - Croydon Urgent Treatment Centre (530 London Road, Thornton Heath, CR7 7YE). Open 24/7 for urgent clinical needs; follow directions to Croydon University Hospital above. 3. Local Hazard Notes: The Caterham Bourne (intermittent chalk stream) flows through the Caterham Bourne Valley towards Purley Cross. Ground-water and surface flooding present severe risks at the A22/A23 junction, Godstone Road, and lower Brighton Road during prolonged winter rainfall. 4. Essential Supplies: Pharmacies and large supermarkets on Brighton Road, Purley High Street, and Purley Way (A23) supply clean bottled water, hygiene kits, and emergency medications. Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
